company_name: Barrick Mining Corporation (formerly Barrick Gold Corporation)

equity_bridge.item: Less H1-2026 attributable FCF already in the 30-Jun-2026 net cash (year-1 flow counts the full FY2026)
equity_bridge.note: Q2-2026 MD&A p.38: H1-2026 attributable free cash flow $1,354m

equity_bridge.item: Newmont $1.95bn cash top-up for Fourmile vend-in to NGM, after ~22% tax
equity_bridge.note: Agreed 2026-08-09, post balance date, receivable on closing; 38.5% of Fourmile given up is not separately in the flows (gold volumes only hold ~flat after FY2029), so the net cash is additive. Taxed at an assumed 22% US rate.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: forward volume deck at mid-cycle prices (gold 3.07 -> 3.75Moz, copper 205 -> 410kt by FY2032, ~3%/yr volume) - the historical CAGRs are gold-price artefacts, not a growth rate
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (2.6-5.3%) diverges >30% from revenue (6-16%) and EPS (17-130%): FY2022 was a trough (EPS $0.24, FCF $432m) and FY2025 a record ($3,501/oz gold), so every trailing CAGR measures the gold price cycle rather than the business. Consolidated FCF 5-yr CAGR is 2.8% because FY2020 was itself a price peak.
historical_growth.notes: Attributable series used where published: revenue-as-adjusted FY2021 9,829 / FY2022 9,147 / FY2023 9,411 / FY2024 10,724 / FY2025 13,950; attributable EBITDA 5,247 / 4,029 / 3,987 / 5,185 / 8,157; attributable FCF FY2023 399 / FY2024 1,091 / FY2025 2,837 (earlier years not disclosed on this basis). Consolidated CAGRs from Metrics.csv: revenue FY2020 12,595 -> FY2025 16,956; FCF 3,363 -> 3,868; equity 23,341 -> 26,557; EPS 1.31 -> 2.93.

scenario_narratives.base: Gold mean-reverts from the $4,200-4,600 of 2026 to a $3,400/oz mid-cycle by FY2029 while Barrick delivers the three-year outlook: Loulo-Gounkoto back at full rate, Goldrush/Cortez and Kibali lift gold to ~3.6Moz, Lumwana Super Pit takes copper to ~290kt by FY2030, and a slowed Reko Diq Phase 1 adds ~110kt copper and ~150koz gold at 50% from FY2031. Attributable EBITDA margin compresses from 63% to ~50% as the price falls faster than TCC (royalty relief offsets some inflation). Capex peaks at ~$4.2bn attributable in FY2027-28 then falls to ~$3bn sustaining-plus-replacement, so owner FCF troughs at ~$2.4bn in FY2028-29 before recovering to ~$4.5bn. Dividend policy (50% of attributable FCF) and the $3bn buyback are value-neutral distributions of these flows. Axes: the gold price deck, Reko Diq timing/cost, and whether the African portfolio stays operable.
scenario_narratives.bull: The central-bank-driven gold regime holds: gold stays ~$4,200/oz and copper ~$5.50/lb (both still below the 2026 peaks). Reko Diq clears its review and starts on the original FY2029 schedule, Fourmile is fast-tracked inside the expanded NGM, Pueblo Viejo expansion and Lumwana deliver, and gold volumes reach ~4Moz with copper ~460kt. Margins hold near 60% and owner FCF climbs toward $8bn. The North American Barrick IPO crystallises a Tier One premium on NGM/Pueblo Viejo, but that is a multiple event and is not in the flows. This needs the price regime, the Pakistan project and the African jurisdictions all to go right at once.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold reverses as it did in 2013: real rates and the dollar turn, central-bank buying slows, and the realised price falls to $2,700/oz by FY2029 with copper at $4.00/lb on a Chinese slowdown. A second resource-nationalism episode (Tanzania, DRC, Zambia royalty, or the Mali code being applied in full) removes ~250koz a year and the review shelves Reko Diq after FY2027 capex has been sunk. Margins fall to ~35%, unit costs rise on fixed-cost dilution, cash tax creeps to 29%, and owner FCF settles near $1bn a year. The balance sheet survives comfortably (net cash, $5.9bn liquidity); this is a value-compression case, not a solvency case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Barrick on what a mid-cycle gold and copper price pays its shareholders, not on the FY2025/H1-2026 peak. All flows are attributable (Barrick's own basis) so Newmont's 38.5% of NGM and the host-government minorities are charged once and never deducted again at book. SBC is cash-settled and already inside the flows, so it is not deducted twice; the share count is flat. Cyclical and jurisdiction risk live in the scenario decks and weights, not in the discount rate, which is the same 9% USD WACC in all three cases. Terminal value is capped at 13x owner FCF because a buyer of a cyclical does not pay a Gordon multiple built on a trough-free perpetuity. The hurdle entry price is the price that returns 15% if the weighted scenario plays out with the terminal value rebuilt at 15%.
key_risks_to_valuation: The mid-cycle gold assumption ($3,400/oz base) is the single largest driver: each $100/oz changes attributable EBITDA by ~$300m/yr (company sensitivity) and the base value by roughly US$1.3/share
Reko Diq capital cost and timing (50% share of an $8.83bn+ Phase 1 under security review) - the base assumes a two-year slip and ~25% overrun
Resource nationalism: Mali's 2023 code, the 10-year-only Loulo licence, Tanzania/DRC/Zambia/PNG exposures - modelled as a 250koz/yr loss in the bear case only
Capex intensity: FY2026-28 attributable capex of ~$4.0-4.2bn/yr means owner FCF troughs near $2.4bn even at $3,500 gold; any further escalation hits the near-term flows directly

Corporate restructuring (North American Barrick IPO, expanded NGM JV) could change the consolidation basis; attributable flows are robust to that but the headline consolidated statements will not be comparable
Timing convention: FY2026 is discounted a full year with nine months elapsed, and the H1-2026 cash is removed in the bridge - both conservative

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (TSX regular close); 52-week range C$42.62-74.00; parity-checked against NYSE 'B' at USDCAD 1.4253. Gold/copper spot from Yahoo GC=F / HG=F same date.
data_sources.financials: ABX.TO_Metrics.csv (consolidated, USD millions, FY2015-Q2 2026); FY2025 annual MD&A (attributable EBITDA/FCF/capex reconciliations p.58, 2026 guidance p.9-10, three-year outlook); Q2-2026 MD&A (revised capex guidance $3.8-4.2bn, Reko Diq review, H1 attributable flows, balance sheet, share count, buyback); FY2023/FY2024 annuals for the attributable history.
data_sources.qualitative: ABX.TO_Analysis.json (2026-10-10): Mali resolution, Fourmile/NGM-Newmont settlement, Reko Diq review, leadership change, 50%-of-attributable-FCF dividend policy.

inputs.base_revenue_basis: FY2025 'Revenues - as adjusted' (Barrick's attributable revenue: consolidated revenue less NCI share plus equity-investee share), FY2025 MD&A p.58. Ties to 3,318koz attributable gold sold x $3,501/oz + 224kt attributable copper x $4.72/lb = $13,947m. Consolidated revenue was $16,956m.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,646m common shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (1,645.9m at 2026-07-30, Q2-2026 MD&A). Basic = diluted (Q2-2026 note: 1,666m weighted both bases) because Barrick's share awards (PGSU/RSU/DSU) are cash-settled or market-purchased, not issued from treasury. Held FLAT; the $3bn buyback authorisation (May 2026, $1.209bn used by June) is value-neutral in this model.
inputs.reported_fcf_basis: FY2025 attributable free cash flow (consolidated FCF $3,868m + equity-investee FCF $585m - NCI share $1,616m), FY2025 MD&A p.58. Owner FCF = 2,837 - 0 SBC - 189 interest received = 2,648. Note FY2025 attributable FCF is after the $253m Mali settlement, $175m divestiture taxes and $291m interest paid; the forward build is unlevered and pre-one-offs.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 note 'Stock-based compensation expense' $270m (FY2024 $65m; FY2026 guidance ~$60m at US$45.76). Barrick's awards are cash-settled or market-purchased (zero dilution: basic = diluted share count, count has only ever fallen via buybacks). The expense is therefore already a CASH cost inside adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow, so it is charged ZERO again here to avoid a double count. SBC rows are kept explicit at 0% (SBC-zero treatment); house and street bases coincide.
inputs.interest_income_basis: FY2025 'Interest received' $189m (cash-flow statement). Stripped from the FY0 owner-FCF anchor because gross cash ($5.9bn) is added back through net debt; the forward EBITDA path is pre-finance so no further adjustment is needed.
inputs.buyback_cash_note: FY2025 $1,500m; H1-2026 a further $1,209m under the $3bn May-2026 authorisation. Repurchaser: the flat count is funded.
inputs.fx_note: USD flows, CAD (TSX) quote. USDCAD 1.4253 = 1/0.7016 (Yahoo CADUSD=X, 2026-10-09 close). Parity check: NYSE 'B' US$41.06 x 1.4253 = C$58.52 vs ABX.TO C$58.53 at the same close (0.02% tie). All per-share values computed in USD and multiplied by fx_rate into CAD; USD twins carried under the _usd suffix.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD-built rate: 10-yr UST ~4.2% + 5.0% ERP x beta 1.0 = 9.2% cost of equity; ~7% debt at 90/10 weights on a net-cash balance sheet gives ~9.0%. Set 9.0% for ALL scenarios. Jurisdiction risk (Mali, Tanzania, DRC, Pakistan, PNG, Argentina) and gold-price cyclicality are charged ONCE, in the scenario flows and weights (bear: nationalism recurrence + Reko Diq shelved + gold at $2,700), not as a WACC premium stacked on top.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities are $17m (FY2025 note) and sit inside total_debt; no lease charge in the flows. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE via attributable-only flows: revenue, EBITDA, D&A and capex are all on Barrick's published attributable basis (61.5% NGM, 60% Pueblo Viejo, 80% Loulo-Gounkoto, 84% North Mara/Bulyanhulu, 45% Kibali, 50% Zaldivar/Jabal Sayid/Reko Diq, 24.5% Porgera). The $9,544m NCI book value is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 attributable EBITDA 8,157 less ~1,800 attributable D&A, taxed at 27% = ~4,640 NOPAT vs adjusted net earnings 4,139 after ~140 net finance costs and other items - within noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with mid-cycle commodity normalisation; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' + owner-fcf-adaptations (currency a1/a2, NCI c, SBC-zero e, risk-once f). No NAV model: Barrick does not publish a reserve-by-reserve NAV and a scenario DCF on attributable flows with explicit price decks is the house equivalent. CYCLE POSITION: FY2025 ($3,501/oz realised) and H1-2026 ($4,613/oz) are peak-cycle; spot gold is $4,216 (52w 3,901-5,586) and copper $6.69/lb. The base deck mean-reverts gold to $3,400/oz and copper to $4.75/lb by FY2029 (then +2%/yr nominal), i.e. ~20% below spot and ~45% above the 2021-25 realised average of $2,286 - the mid-cycle call. Volumes follow the Feb-2026 three-year outlook (gold 2.9-3.25 -> 3.3-3.65 -> 3.4-3.7Moz; copper 190-220 -> 195-225 -> ~255-285kt) then Reko Diq Phase 1 at 50% from FY2031 (base) / FY2029 (bull) / never (bear). EBITDA = oz x (price - TCC) + lb x (price - C1) - ~$700m corporate/exploration/other, calibrated to FY2025 (58%) and H1-2026 (63%). TIMING: year 1 = FY2026 full year discounted one full period although nine months have elapsed (conservative, ~US$0.4/sh); the H1-2026 attributable FCF already inside the 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet is removed in the equity bridge so it is not counted twice. Terminal cap 13x FCF (cyclical range 12-15x) binds in every scenario at WACC 9% / g 2% (Gordon 14.6x). Street basis equals house basis (SBC-zero); band_position is null by construction.

bear.deck_note: Gold $/oz 4,400 / 3,400 / 2,900 / 2,700 / 2,700 then +2% (a 2013-style reversal toward the FY2024 average of $2,397 plus cost inflation); copper 6.10 / 4.75 / 4.25 / 4.00 / 4.00 then +2% (China slowdown). Gold koz 3,000 -> 3,350 (a Mali/Tanzania-type episode costs ~250koz/yr; Fourmile slower); copper kt 200 -> 265 (Lumwana only; Reko Diq shelved after the 2027 security review - FY2026-27 capex spent, no volumes). TCC $1,420 -> $1,730 (fixed costs over fewer ounces); C1 $2.40 -> $2.80. D&A $1,950m -> $2,200m; capex $3,950m / 3,900 / 3,300 / 2,800 / 2,500 then ~2,400-2,550. Tax 29% (mining-code creep: Mali 2023 code precedent spreading).

base.deck_note: Gold $/oz 4,430 / 3,900 / 3,500 / 3,400 / 3,400 then +2%; copper $/lb 6.20 / 5.50 / 5.00 / 4.75 / 4.75 then +2%. Gold koz 3,070 / 3,450 / 3,550 / 3,600 / 3,600 / 3,700 / 3,750 flat; copper kt 205 / 210 / 265 / 280 / 290 / 350 / 400 / 410 (Reko Diq 50% from FY2031). TCC $1,400 -> $1,672 (3%/2.5% inflation, less $5/oz per $100 gold royalty effect, less $50 Fourmile/Reko mix from FY2031); C1 $2.35 -> $2.35. Corporate+exploration+other $700m -> $910m. Attributable D&A $1,950m -> $3,000m; attributable capex $4,000m (guide 3.8-4.2bn) / 4,200 / 4,200 / 3,900 / 3,600 / 3,200 / 2,900 / 2,950 / 3,000 / 3,050. Cash tax 27% (FY2026 ETR guide 24-28%; Nevada, DR, Mali, Zambia, Tanzania, Argentina mix). WC 0: price-driven revenue swings move receivables little; stockpile builds are inside capex guidance.

bull.deck_note: Gold $/oz 4,450 / 4,300 / 4,200 / 4,200 / 4,200 then +2% (the post-2025 central-bank regime holds near spot); copper 6.25 / 6.00 / 5.75 / 5.50 / 5.50 then +2%. Gold koz 3,100 -> 4,050 (Fourmile earlier and larger, Reko Diq gold from FY2029); copper kt 210 -> 460 (Reko Diq on the original FY2029 schedule). TCC $1,400 -> $1,695; C1 $2.35 -> $2.30. D&A $1,950m -> $3,250m; capex $4,100m -> $4,500m peak FY2027-28 -> $3,350m. Tax 26%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because gold at $4,216 is 1.8x the 2021-25 realised average and the base already assumes only a partial (20%) retracement; a full 2013-style reversal is a single macro event with precedent, not a chain of failures. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things to hold - the price regime, Reko Diq on schedule in Pakistan, and no new African dispute - during a leadership transition (new CEO, CFO and Lead Director inside 18 months). Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
